description: Use this when someone wants to know how fast a public web page is, why it's slow, how it does on Core Web Vitals or Lighthouse, or what to fix to speed it up. Runs Google PageSpeed Insights (Lighthouse) and returns performance, accessibility, best-practices and SEO scores, lab measurements, real-user Core Web Vitals when Google has them, and the fixes with the biggest estimated impact. The address is sent to Google, which loads the page. The tool does not edit the target website or submit forms. It only works on public pages, not local sites, pages behind a login or addresses that contain a password or token. An audit takes about 20 to 40 seconds, and the same page's result is reused for up to 12 hours. Don't use it to check whether a site is up, for security scans or for keyword research.

device.description: Test as a phone (the default, and what Google ranks on) or as a desktop.

url.description: The public page to audit, for example example.com or https://example.com/pricing. No passwords, tokens or private links.

name: audit_website_speed
title: Audit a website's speed
